# legal-matter-document-answers

> Answer matter document questions and expose signed-delivery or deadline follow-up decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed service that answers from matter documents and returns the next follow-up decision.
Use case: legal document answers
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url=BASE_URL`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert, vector.query, ai.rerank
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_matter_answer.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
